उद्बन्ध् उद्-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्-
धुम्, to tie up, hang.
उद्-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, tied up, hung.

उद्-बन्ध, अस्, m. or उद्-बन्धन, अम्, n. tying
up, hanging; hanging one's self.
उद्-बन्धुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who hangs up.
उद्बल उद्-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, strong, powerful.

उद्बाहु उद्-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the arms
raised; extending the arms; having the trunk up-
raised (as an elephant).

उद्बिल उद्-बिल, अस्, आ, अम्, out of the hole,
(an animal) that has quitted its hole.

उद्बुध् उद्-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A., Ved. -बोधति,
-ते, -बोधितुम्, to awaken, arouse, excite, remind.

उद्-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, excited, re-
minded, made to think of, recalled; blown, budded.
—उद्बुद्ध-संस्कार, अस्, m. association of ideas,
recalling anything to remembrance.

उद्-बोध, अस्, m. awaking, reminding, incipient
knowledge.

उद्-बोधक, अस्, आ, अम्, exciting; reminding,
what reminds or calls to remembrance; discovering,
exhibiting.

उद्-बोधन, अम्, n. awaking, arousing; recalling,
reminding.
